[[Category:Trough Creek Cemetery, Calvin, Pennsylvania]]
== Biography ==
Benjamin was born in 1827. He was the son of Samuel L. Glasgow and Mary Wilson. He passed away in 1897.
=== Probable father identification ===
The memorial-derived account names Samuel L. Glasgow and Mary Wilson as Benjamin’s parents. Mary Wilson Glasgow, wife of Thomas Enyeart, has the same named parents in the 1914 Fouse genealogy.<ref name="Fouse1914">''Genealogy of the descendants of Theobald Fouse (Fauss)'' (1914), p. 74; [https://archive.org/details/genealogyofdesce01brum/page/n140/mode/1up original scan, IA leaf 140].</ref> [[Glasgow-1984|Samuel Glasgow of Huntingdon (about 1786–1829)]] is the preferred existing father candidate, assessed as 71% probable. The children name the same parental couple, Samuel Glasgow and Mary Wilson, in the Huntingdon, Pennsylvania family setting. Samuel Glasgow-1984 is the existing compatible Huntingdon man, with a contributed birth about 1786 in Antis and a held memorial death of 22 July 1829. These dates permit fatherhood in 1814 and 1827, at about 28 and 41. The shared full parental couple and locality give a stronger match than the forename Samuel alone. No inspected probate, household, church or cemetery record yet identifies Samuel Glasgow-1984 as this Mary Wilson’s husband or either child’s father. His approximate birth and locality are inherited profile claims, not newly verified records. The memorial pages were not freshly inspected. The memorial and 1914 book may share a source and are not independent proofs. A missing middle initial on Samuel’s profile is not a conflict; Benjamin’s captured account calls the father Samuel L. The identity remains open to another compatible Samuel. The exact percentage is a subjective assessment of the complete identification with the existing Samuel Glasgow-1984, not merely of a named Samuel father. The existing-profile identification remains probable. Mary Wilson is assessed separately as the reported mother; no numbered mother, spouse or upstream parent is assigned.
